verses.text: E better to get dry morsel with quietness than house full of feasting with strife.
Wise servant go rule over di shameful pikin and share di inheritance among di brothers.
Di refining pot na for silver, and di furnace for gold, but di Lord dey test hearts.
Evildoer dey listen to wicked lips. Liar dey pay attention to destructive tongue.
Whoever mock di poor dey insult im Maker. Whoever rejoice for calamity no go go unpunished.
Pikin dem pikin na crown of old men, and di glory of pikin dem na dem papa dem.
Excellent speech no fit fool, how much less lying lips for prince.
Bribe na precious stone for di eyes of di one wey get am. Wherever e turn, e dey prosper.
Whoever cover offense dey seek love, but whoever repeat matter dey separate close friends.
Rebuke dey enter deeper for man wey get understanding pass 100 lashes for fool.
Evil man dey seek only rebellion, so cruel messenger go dey sent against am.
Make man meet bear wey don lose im cubs, rather than fool for im folly.
Whoever return evil for good, evil no go leave im house.
Di beginning of strife na like release of water, so stop quarrel before e burst out.
Whoever justify di wicked and whoever condemn di righteous, both na abomination to di Lord.
Wetin be di use of money for fool hand to buy wisdom, since e no get sense?
Friend dey love at all times, and brother dey born for time of adversity.
Man wey lack sense dey shake hands and become guarantor for im neighbor.
Whoever love disobedience love strife. Whoever make im gate high dey seek destruction.
Man wey get crooked heart no dey find good, and whoever get perverse tongue dey fall into trouble.
Whoever born fool dey bring grief, and papa of fool no get joy.
Cheerful heart na good medicine, but crushed spirit dey dry up di bones.
Wicked man dey accept bribe from secret to pervert di ways of justice.
Wisdom dey before di face of di one wey get understanding, but di eyes of fool dey di ends of di earth.
Foolish pikin na grief to im papa and bitterness to di one wey born am.
To punish di righteous no good, nor to strike noble people for uprightness.
Whoever restrain im words get knowledge, and whoever get cool spirit na man of understanding.
Even fool dey count as wise when e keep quiet. When e shut im lips, e dey count as prudent.
Whoever isolate imself dey seek im own desire and dey rage against all sound judgment.
Fool no delight for understanding, but only for expressing im own opinion.
When wickedness come, contempt dey come too, and with dishonor come reproach.
Di words of man mouth na deep waters. Di fountain of wisdom na flowing brook.
E no good to show partiality to di wicked, or to deprive di innocent of justice.
Di lips of fool dey bring quarrel, and im mouth dey invite beating.
Di mouth of fool na im ruin, and im lips na snare to im soul.
Di words of gossip na like delicious morsels. Dem go down into di inner parts.
Whoever dey slack for im work na brother to am wey destroy.
Di name of di Lord na strong tower. Di righteous run into am and dey safe.
Di rich man wealth na im strong city, and like high wall for im imagination.
Before destruction di heart of man dey proud, but humility dey come before honor.
Whoever give answer before e hear, e na folly and shame to am.
Man spirit go sustain am for sickness, but crushed spirit, who fit bear am?
Di heart of di prudent dey get knowledge, and di ear of di wise dey seek knowledge.
Man gift dey make room for am and bring am before great men.
Di first to plead im case dey seem right, until another come and examine am.
Di lot dey end quarrels and dey decide between strong opponents.
Offended brother harder to win pass strong city, and quarrels dey like bars of castle.
Man belly go dey filled with di fruit of im mouth. E go dey satisfied with di harvest of im lips.
Death and life dey di power of di tongue, and dem wey love am go eat im fruit.
Whoever find wife find good thing and obtain favor from di Lord.
Di poor dey plead for mercy, but di rich dey answer roughly.
Man of many companions fit come to ruin, but friend dey wey stick closer pass brother.
Poor man wey waka for im integrity better pass person wey perverse for im speech and na fool.
Desire without knowledge no good, and whoever hurry with im feet go miss di way.
Man foolishness dey ruin im way, and im heart dey rage against di Lord.
Wealth dey add plenty friends, but di poor man friend dey separate from am.
False witness no go go unpunished, and whoever breathe out lies no go escape.
Many dey seek di favor of generous man, and everyone na friend to man wey dey give gifts.
All di brothers of di poor hate am. How much more im friends dey go far from am! E dey pursue dem with words, but dem don go.
Whoever get wisdom love im own soul. Whoever keep understanding go find good.
False witness no go go unpunished, and whoever breathe out lies go perish.
Luxury no fit fool, how much less for servant to rule over princes.
Man good sense dey make am slow to anger, and e na im glory to overlook offense.
Di wrath of di king dey like roaring of lion, but im favor dey like dew on di grass.
Foolish pikin na calamity to im papa, and wife wey dey quarrel na like constant dripping of water.
House and riches na inheritance from papa dem, but prudent wife dey from di Lord.
Laziness dey throw person into deep sleep, and idle man go suffer hunger.
Whoever keep commandment dey keep im soul, but whoever despise im ways go die.
Whoever dey kind to di poor dey lend to di Lord, and e go repay am for im deed.
Discipline your pikin, because e still get hope, and no set your heart on im destruction.
Man of great anger go pay di penalty, because if you rescue am, you go still dey do am again.
Listen to advice and accept instruction, so dat you go dey wise for di end.
Many plans dey man heart, but na di purpose of di Lord go stand.
Wetin make man dey desirable na im kindness, and poor man better pass liar.
Di fear of di Lord dey lead to life. Whoever get am go rest satisfied and no go dey visited by harm.
Di lazy man bury im hand for di dish. E no even fit bring am back to im mouth.
Strike scoffer, and di simple go learn prudence. Rebuke man wey get understanding, and e go gain knowledge.
Whoever rob im papa and drive away im mama na pikin wey dey cause shame and disgrace.
Cease, my pikin, to hear instruction wey go make you stray from words of knowledge.
Corrupt witness dey mock justice, and di mouth of di wicked dey swallow iniquity.
Penalties dey ready for scoffers, and beatings for di backs of fools.
Wine na mocker, strong drink na brawler, and whoever dey led astray by am no dey wise.
Di terror of di king dey like roaring of lion. Whoever provoke am to anger dey forfeit im own life.
E na honor for man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool dey quarrel.
Di lazy man no dey plow for autumn, so for harvest e go seek and get nothing.
Di purpose for man heart na like deep water, but man of understanding go draw am out.
Most men go proclaim im own steadfast love, but who fit find faithful man?
Di righteous man dey waka for im integrity. Blessed na im pikin dem after am.
King wey sit on throne of judgment dey winnow all evil with im eyes.
Who fit talk say, “I don make my heart clean. I don clean from my sin”?
Differing weights and differing measures, di Lord hate both of dem.
Even pikin dey make imself known by im acts, whether im conduct dey pure and right.
Di hearing ear and di seeing eye, di Lord don make both of dem.
No love sleep, or you go come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you go dey satisfied with bread.
“E bad, e bad,” di buyer dey talk, but when e go im way, e dey boast.
Gold dey, and plenty rubies dey, but lips of knowledge na precious jewel.
Take di garment of am wey guarantee for stranger, and hold am in pledge when e dey guarantee for foreigner.
Bread wey dem gain by deceit dey sweet to man, but afterward im mouth go dey filled with gravel.
Plans dey established by counsel, and by wise guidance make war.
Whoever go about as slanderer dey reveal secrets, so no associate with man wey talk too much.
Whoever curse im papa or im mama, im lamp go dey put out for deep darkness.
Inheritance wey dem gather quick for di beginning no go dey blessed for di end.
No talk say, “I go pay back evil.” Wait for di Lord, and e go save you.
Differing weights na abomination to di Lord, and false scales no good.
Man steps dey from di Lord, so how man go understand im own way?
E na snare for man to say rashly, “Holy!” and to reconsider only after vows.
Wise king dey winnow di wicked and dey drive di threshing wheel over dem.
Di spirit of man na di lamp of di Lord, wey dey search all im inmost parts.
Steadfast love and faithfulness dey preserve di king, and by steadfast love e dey uphold im throne.
Di glory of young men na dem strength, but di splendor of old men na gray hair.
Blows wey wound dey cleanse away evil, and strokes dey reach di inner parts.
Di heart of di king dey for di hand of di Lord like water streams. E dey turn am wherever e want.
Every way of man dey right for im own eyes, but di Lord dey weigh di hearts.
To do righteousness and justice dey more acceptable to di Lord pass sacrifice.
Haughty eyes and proud heart, di lamp of di wicked, na sin.
Di plans of di diligent lead only to plenty, but everyone wey hurry dey come only to poverty.
Treasures wey dem gain by lying tongue na fleeting vapor for dem wey seek death.
Di violence of di wicked go sweep dem away, because dem refuse to do justice.
Di way of guilty man dey crooked, but di conduct of di innocent dey straight.
E better to dey for corner of housetop than to share house with quarrelsome wife.
Di soul of di wicked dey desire evil. Im neighbor no dey find favor for im eyes.
When scoffer dey punished, di simple dey gain wisdom, and when wise man dey instructed, e dey receive knowledge.
Di Righteous One dey consider di house of di wicked. E dey bring di wicked to ruin.
Whoever shut im ear to di cry of di poor go cry out too and no go dey answered.
Gift wey dem give for secret dey calm anger, and bribe wey dem hide for bosom dey calm great wrath.
When justice dey done, e dey joy to di righteous, but terror to evildoers.
Man wey wander from di way of understanding go rest for di assembly of di dead.
Whoever love pleasure go become poor man. Whoever love wine and oil no go get rich.
Di wicked na ransom for di righteous, and di treacherous take di place of di upright.
E better to dwell for desert land than with quarrelsome and fretful wife.
Precious treasure and oil dey for di house of di wise, but fool dey swallow am up.
Whoever pursue righteousness and kindness go find life, righteousness and honor.
Wise man dey scale city of di mighty and bring down di stronghold wey dem dey trust.
Whoever guard im mouth and im tongue dey keep imself out of trouble.
“Scoffer” na di name of proud and haughty man, wey dey act with arrogant pride.
Di desire of di lazy man go kill am, because im hands refuse to labor.
All day long e dey crave and crave, but di righteous dey give and no dey hold back.
Di sacrifice of di wicked na abomination, how much more when e bring am with evil intent.
False witness go perish, but di man wey listen go speak forever.
Di wicked man dey put on bold face, but di upright dey consider im ways.
No wisdom, no understanding, no counsel fit stand against di Lord.
Di horse dey ready for di day of battle, but victory belong to di Lord.
Good name dey more to dey chosen pass great riches, and favor better pass silver or gold.
Rich and poor meet together. Di Lord na di Maker of dem all.
Prudent man dey see danger and hide imself, but di simple dey go on and suffer for am.
Di reward for humility and di fear of di Lord na riches, honor and life.
Thorns and snares dey for di way of di crooked. Whoever guard im soul go keep far from dem.
Train up pikin for di way e suppose waka, and even when e old, e no go depart from am.
Di rich dey rule over di poor, and di borrower na servant to di lender.
Whoever sow injustice go reap calamity, and di rod of im anger go fail.
Whoever get generous eye go dey blessed, because e dey share im bread with di poor.
Drive out scoffer, and quarrel go go. Strife and abuse go stop.
Whoever love purity of heart, and wey im speech dey gracious, di king go be im friend.
Di eyes of di Lord dey watch over knowledge, but e dey overthrow di words of di treacherous.
Di lazy man talk say, “Lion dey outside! I go dey killed for di streets!”
Di mouth of foreign woman na deep pit. Di one wey di Lord dey angry with go fall into am.
Foolishness dey tie for di heart of pikin, but di rod of discipline go drive am far from am.
Whoever oppress di poor to increase im riches, or give to di rich, go only come to want.
Bend your ear and hear di words of di wise, and apply your heart to my knowledge,
because e dey pleasant if you keep dem inside you, if dem dey ready together for your lips.
So dat your trust go dey for di Lord, I don make dem known to you today, even to you.
I don write to you 30 sayings of counsel and knowledge,
to make you know di certainty of di words of truth, so dat you go answer words of truth to dem wey send you?
No rob di poor because e poor, and no crush di afflicted for di gate,
because di Lord go plead dem cause and rob of life dem wey rob dem.
No make friends with man wey get hot temper, and no go with man wey dey quick to rage,
or you go learn im ways and get snare for your soul.
No be one of dem wey shake hands, one of dem wey guarantee debts.
If you no get anything to pay, why dem go take your bed from under you?
No move di ancient boundary stone wey your papa dem set.
You see man wey dey skillful for im work? E go stand before kings. E no go stand before obscure men.
When you sit to dine with ruler, consider carefully wetin dey before you,
and put knife to your throat if you dey given to appetite.
No desire im delicacies, because dem na deceptive food.
No labor to get rich. Cease from your own understanding.
Make your eyes fly to am, and e don go. Because riches surely make wings for dem self like eagle wey fly toward di sky.
No eat di bread of man wey get stingy eye, and no desire im delicacies,
because as e think inside im heart, so e be. “Eat and drink,” e talk to you, but im heart no dey with you.
Di morsel wey you don eat, you go vomit am up and waste your pleasant words.
No speak for di ears of fool, because e go despise di wisdom of your words.
No move di ancient boundary stone, and no enter di fields of di orphans,
because dem Redeemer strong. E go plead dem cause against you.
Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
No withhold discipline from pikin. If you beat am with rod, e no go die.
You go beat am with rod and deliver im soul from Sheol.
My pikin, if your heart dey wise, my own heart go dey glad too.
My inmost being go rejoice when your lips speak wetin dey right.
No let your heart envy sinners, but continue for di fear of di Lord all day long.
Surely dere dey future, and your hope no go cut off.
Hear, my pikin, and dey wise, and guide your heart for di way.
No dey among wine drinkers, among gluttonous eaters of meat,
because di drunkard and di glutton go come to poverty, and drowsiness go clothe man with rags.
Listen to your papa wey get you, and no despise your mama when e old.
Buy truth, and no sell am. Buy wisdom, instruction and understanding.
Di papa of di righteous go greatly rejoice, and whoever father wise pikin go delight for am.
Make your papa and your mama dey glad. Make di one wey born you rejoice.
My pikin, give me your heart, and make your eyes delight for my ways.
Because prostitute na deep pit, and foreign woman na narrow well.
E dey lie in wait like robber and dey increase di unfaithful among men.
Who get woe? Who get sorrow? Who get strife? Who get complaining? Who get wounds without cause? Who get redness of eyes?
Dem wey stay late for di wine, dem wey go try mixed wine.
No look for di wine when e red, when e sparkle for di cup, when e go down smoothly.
For di end e bite like serpent and sting like viper.
Your eyes go see strange things, and your heart go speak perverse things.
Yes, you go be like man wey lie down for di middle of di sea, or like man wey lie down for di top of mast.
“Dem strike me,” you go talk, “but I no dey hurt. Dem beat me, but I no feel am. When I go wake up? I go seek am again.”
No envy evil men, and no desire to dey with dem,
because dem heart dey plan violence, and dem lips dey talk trouble.
By wisdom dem dey build house, and by understanding e dey established.
By knowledge di rooms dey filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
Wise man dey full of strength, and man of knowledge dey increase power,
because by wise guidance you fit wage war, and for plenty counselors dey victory.
Wisdom too high for fool. For di gate e no dey open im mouth.
Whoever plan to do evil go dey called schemer.
Di plotting of folly na sin, and di scoffer na abomination to men.
If you faint for di day of trouble, your strength small.
Rescue dem wey dem dey take away to death, and hold back dem wey dey stagger to slaughter.
If you talk say, “Look, we no know dis,” di one wey weigh di heart no consider am? Di one wey keep your soul no know am, and e no go repay man according to im work?
My pikin, eat honey, because e good, and di honeycomb dey sweet to your taste.
Know say wisdom dey sweet like dat to your soul. If you find am, den dere go be future, and your hope no go cut off.
No lie in wait, wicked man, against di home of di righteous. No destroy im dwelling place,
because di righteous fall seven times and rise again, but di wicked dey stumble for calamity.
No rejoice when your enemy fall, and make your heart no dey glad when e stumble,
or di Lord go see am and e go displease am, and e go turn away im anger from am.
No fret because of evildoers, and no envy di wicked,
because di evil man get no future. Di lamp of di wicked go dey put out.
My pikin, fear di Lord and di king, and no join with dem wey dey given to change,
because dem calamity go rise sudden, and who know di ruin wey dem two fit bring?
Dis too na sayings of di wise. To show partiality for judgment no good.
Whoever talk to di wicked say, “You dey righteous,” peoples go curse am. Nations go denounce am,
but e go dey well with dem wey rebuke am, and rich blessing go come on dem.
Whoever give honest answer dey kiss di lips.
Prepare your work outside. Get am ready for yourself for di field, and afterward build your house.
No be witness against your neighbor without cause, and no deceive with your lips.
No talk say, “I go do to am as e do to me. I go repay di man according to im work.”
I waka pass di field of di lazy man, and di vineyard of man wey lack sense.
Look, e don full of thorns. Nettles don cover im face, and im stone wall don break down.
Den I see am, and I consider am. I look, and I receive instruction.
Small sleep, small slumber, small folding of di hands to rest,
so your poverty go come like robber, and your want like armed man.
